acts.desc: The visions, the gold plates, and the claims the church was built on

acts.name: What happened out west
acts.desc: Polygamy in the open, a priesthood ban, and the killings at Mountain Meadows

acts.name: What came out later
acts.desc: The papyri, the quiet edits, and the money — found, admitted, or ruled on

turningPoints.1830–33: Joseph Smith wrote a prophecy naming himself into Genesis; no ancient manuscript contains those verses
turningPoints.1832: A temple was promised at Independence within that generation; the generation passed and none was built
turningPoints.1843: Plural marriage was written into scripture, with Emma named and threatened in the revelation itself
turningPoints.1890–1904: Polygamy was publicly ended while roughly 250 new plural marriages were quietly authorized anyway
turningPoints.1966: The lost papyri turned up; the only translation anyone could check did not match
turningPoints.2023: Federal regulators found $32 billion hidden behind thirteen shell companies, and the church settled
